origin: OpenCode 1.18.16: the relay refuses its own key (401); a plain 401 does not cross to another account or tier, so the client is told 401 although the native tier could have served it. The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and reasoning_effort is the medium OpenCode sends for it (its verbosity field is left out, see extra-opencode-gpt-request-with-verbosity). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
